thread:
Lucy Nguyen: quick heads-up — I'm seeing embedding mismatch after long-context handoff on the new 30k-window rwi-quant model. Repro steps below.
Jin Park: can you paste the minimal repro?
Lucy Nguyen: steps:
1) send convo with prompt A (len ~28k tokens)
2) subsequent request uses continuous KV cache
3) embedding for token 27532 differs from cold-run embedding
Jin Park: hmm, is it RoPE wrap or cache alignment?
Lucy Nguyen: logs show sudden phase offset at ~2^15 position. snippet:
```
cache_index: 27532
rotary_phase: -1.256e+01 -> -1.242e+01
embedding_norm_delta: 0.0032
```
Omar Patel: did you run with kv-ttl or prefix trimming?
Lucy Nguyen: ttl disabled. We run with `--cache-infer=continuous` on dedicated.
Sree Raman: could be quantization noise interacting with rotary interpolation. What quant bits?
Lucy Nguyen: q4_0 static per-device, default kernel. Also tried q4_k_mixed -> same drift but smaller.
dev-bot: nightly-run 2025-08-08 02:00: baked model rwi-30k-q4_0 passed token-level self-consistency (0.2%).
Jin Park: try forcing no-rotary-rescale patch from PR #1423?
Lucy Nguyen: tried patch — drift moved earlier but persisted. attaching small trace (pastebin link)
Omar Patel: can you run `python eval/kv_consistency.py --model rwi-30k-q4_0 --start 27000 --end 27600` and dump attention matrices at 27532?
Lucy Nguyen: running now, ETA 6m
Lucy Nguyen: results: attention rows look shifted, KV keys appear duplicated around wrap boundary.
Sree Raman: if keys duplicate, maybe wrap logic that reindexes positions when seq_len > 2^15 triggers a negative offset. Check `pos_base` code.
Jin Park: also compare with cold-run forward at same absolute token index (no cache) to see if kernel path diverges.
Lucy Nguyen: doing cold-run, cold-run embedding matches expected. so it's cache-path specific.
Omar Patel: workaround: for now set `cache_rebase=false` and restart workers. that'll avoid reindexing.
Lucy Nguyen: rollback applied on a small pool, nightly tests now green so far :thumbsup: 
Jin Park: opened issue infra/eng-ml#518 with logs & reproducer.
Lucy Nguyen: thanks — leaving more traces in the ticket. follow-up: we should add a regression test that runs wrap-around range in quantized kernels.
Sree Raman: I'll add a unit test in runtime/tests/test_rope_wrap.py that runs q4_0 and q4_k variants.
Lucy Nguyen: awesome. marking as next milestone for model-onboard checklist.
dev-bot: deploy patch queued to canary pool (id: canary-33) — monitor token error rate.
Omar Patel: noted, will watch console alerts.
Lucy Nguyen: thanks all.
